title: Principal group
description: spec of the Group manifest: the group's capabilities, data classes and daily limit. The privileged flag is computed by apply and is not written by hand (PRM-13).

caps.description: Group capabilities; an asterisk only at the end of task:<prefix>.* (PRM-7).

data.description: Data classes that the group can see (data:<class>).

inherits.description: Groups whose capabilities are included in this one.

day_eur.description: Daily limit of a group principal in euros; counts only the work line (BUD-1).
